_comment: HarvestCore world rules. 5 cascades: (1) daily clock/weather → watered state → out-of-season death. (2) crop growth → stage transforms. (3) sell loop: deposit → gold. (4) animal care: hunger decay → produce timer → produce spawn. (5) NPC ambient schedule. IMPORTANT: world.* formula bindings read from env['world'] (loaded from world.json['state']) which is NOT auto-synced from world_clock entity state. All weather/season-conditional rules use contact triggers between world_clock entity (position -220,-220) and target entities with radius=1000 (covers full map). Entity state is the canonical source. Total: 47 rules.

rules._comment: === WORLD CLOCK RULES. time_of_day increments each tick; full day = ticks_per_day ticks. dawn_advance_day fires every 60 ticks and emits day_start for the dawn chain. ===
rules._comment2: Increments time_of_day by 1/60 per tick. Clamped naturally by dawn_advance_day resetting to 0 at day boundary.

rules._comment: Fires every 60 ticks. Increments day, updates season (floor(day/28) mod 4), resets time_of_day to 0, emits day_start. interval=60 must match ticks_per_day in world.json.

Draws new weather value on day_start signal. Season-weighted probability. Spring: 10% storm, 40% rain. Summer: 5% storm, 20% rain. Autumn: 15% storm, 30% rain. Winter: 5% storm, 20% rain. Two randf() calls in nested ternary to model cumulative probability. Result stored in world_clock.state.weather for contact-rule weather checks.

effect.value: ((2 if randf() < 0.1 else (1 if randf() < 0.4 else 0)) if self.state.season == 0 else ((2 if randf() < 0.05 else (1 if randf() < 0.2 else 0)) if self.state.season == 1 else ((2 if randf() < 0.15 else (1 if randf() < 0.3 else 0)) if self.state.season == 2 else (2 if randf() < 0.05 else (1 if randf() < 0.2 else 0)))))

rules._comment: At dawn, resets watered=0 on all planted crops unconditionally. If today is rainy, crop_rain_watered (contact rule) will immediately re-set watered=1 in the same tick's react phase.
Clears fed_today on all livestock each dawn.

=== CROP GROWTH RULES. Weather checks use contact trigger between world_clock (a) and crops (b) with radius=1000 to cover the full map. This avoids world.* formula bindings which are not synced from entity state. ===
rules._comment2: While it is raining (world_clock weather==1), all planted crops are continuously watered via large-radius contact. Fires in react phase each tick. After dawn_reset_watered clears all crops, this re-waters them on rainy days.

rules._comment: Each tick, caches season validity for all planted crops. Uses contact between world_clock (a) and crop (b) so formula can access a.state.season and b.properties.season_mask. Bitmask: (1 << season) & mask != 0 means in-season. Fires every tick — cheap state update, idempotent.

Out-of-season crops transform to dead_crop. Fires via contact (world_clock near all crops) on planted_crop with season_valid==0. Once transformed, entity loses planted_crop tag — rule stops firing for it. Implements GDD Q6: seasonal deadline with visual dead_crop feedback.

Core growth tick. Fires every 2 ticks on watered, in-season planted crops. grow_rate property on crop entity determines growth per tick. Interval=2 means crops grow ~30 times per in-game day at ticks_per_day=60.
Seed → young stage transition at growth>=100. transform preserves growth and crop_type property (state merge in _transform).
Young → mature stage transition at growth>=200. crop_mature gains harvestable tag from def, enabling scythe harvest rules.

During storms (world_clock weather==2), each harvestable crop has a small chance per tick of being destroyed. radius=1000 covers full map. Each (world_clock, crop) pair independently rolls — stochastic per-crop. chance=0.008 per tick gives ~0.5%/sec; at 4 mature crops: ~2 crop losses over a 60-second storm on average. Tunable by qa-tester.
=== PLAYER MOVEMENT ===
=== PLAYER TOOL RULES (input: discrete actions) ===
rules._comment2: Cycles held_tool 0→1→2→0. Two effects: add 1 then wrap mod 3. 0=watering_can, 1=hoe, 2=scythe.

rules._comment: Cycles selected_seed 0..4 wrapping via mod on num_seed_types property.
=== CONTACT TOOL RULES. All spatial tool actions use contact trigger. Tool gated by player.state.held_tool. ===
rules._comment2: Player (hoe equipped) contacts dirt_tile → transforms to tilled_soil. Single-fire: after transform, tile loses tillable tag.

rules._comment: Player (hoe) contacts dead_crop → removes it. The tilled_soil tile beneath is still there; player can re-plant next.
Player (watering_can) near tilled or planted entity → sets watered=1. tags_any matches tilled_soil (plantable tag) and all crop stages (planted_crop tag).

When a crop's on_tile relation is removed (by remove/clear_entity), clear the tile's occupied flag. Uses relation_changed trigger. 'to' binding = tile entity id. Handles both player harvest and storm removal.
=== HARVEST RULES (5 per crop type — spawn.template must be a literal string). remove clears on_tile via clear_entity; crop_removed_free_tile handles tile occupied reset. ===
=== PLANT RULES (5 per seed type — contact trigger, nearest unoccupied tile). ===
rules._comment2: Player with selected_seed=0 contacts unoccupied tilled tile → spawn crop_seed with radish properties. After spawn, tile occupied=1 prevents repeat planting same tick.

rules._comment: Potato grows in Spring (mask=1) AND Autumn (mask=4). season_mask = 1+4 = 5.
Player walks near animal → hunger=0, fed_today=1. Contact-based: player must approach each day. Animal produce-timer countdown requires fed_today=1.

Player walks within 48px of sell_chest → emits deposit_trigger signal. Signal-triggered deposit rules then loop over all held produce items (via in_inventory tag) regardless of their stored position. This avoids the contact-proximity issue with produce items (which stay at their spawn position, not following the player).
On deposit_trigger signal, each in_inventory produce item adds its sell_value to farm_ledger_1 gold. self=each produce item. Literal target 'farm_ledger_1' resolves to the singleton economy entity.
Removes produce after gold is collected. after deposit_collect_gold ensures gold is added before entity is removed.
Player contacts loose produce → relate held_by + tag in_inventory. tags_none: in_inventory prevents re-pickup of already-held items.
=== ANIMAL PRODUCTION RULES ===
rules._comment2: Hunger increases 1 per day on day_start signal. Clamped 0-100. At 100 animal stops producing (produce_timer stalls) but no death (GDD Q7: no punishing cascade).

rules._comment: produce_timer counts down every tick only on fed animals (fed_today==1). Unfed animals stall — produce pauses but no punishment.
Chicken: when produce_timer<=0, spawn egg at chicken position + reset timer (produce_interval * ticks_per_day + jitter). Timer jitter = ±1 day via randf()*60.
=== NPC SCHEDULE RULES. Schedule signals emitted when time_of_day is in a narrow window. NPCs velocity_set toward their destination. arrive_stop zeroes velocity when close. ===
rules._comment2: Emits time_work when time_of_day is in [0.3, 0.317). Window = 1 tick at ticks_per_day=60. Query on world_state so self=world_clock_1 at firing.

rules._comment: On time_work signal, set NPC velocity toward work_position. Direction = normalized(target - pos) * speed. max(dist,1) avoids division by zero when already at target.

Every tick, halt NPCs within 28px of their current phase destination. schedule_phase 0=home, 1=work, 2=social. Formula selects the right waypoint by phase, computes distance, zeroes velocity if close. If not close, preserves current velocity components.

effect.x: 0 if sqrt(pow((self.properties.home_position[0] if self.state.schedule_phase == 0 else (self.properties.work_position[0] if self.state.schedule_phase == 1 else self.properties.social_position[0])) - self.state.position[0], 2) + pow((self.properties.home_position[1] if self.state.schedule_phase == 0 else (self.properties.work_position[1] if self.state.schedule_phase == 1 else self.properties.social_position[1])) - self.state.position[1], 2)) < 28 else self.state.velocity[0]
effect.y: 0 if sqrt(pow((self.properties.home_position[0] if self.state.schedule_phase == 0 else (self.properties.work_position[0] if self.state.schedule_phase == 1 else self.properties.social_position[0])) - self.state.position[0], 2) + pow((self.properties.home_position[1] if self.state.schedule_phase == 0 else (self.properties.work_position[1] if self.state.schedule_phase == 1 else self.properties.social_position[1])) - self.state.position[1], 2)) < 28 else self.state.velocity[1]
